issues.claim: Your published route to a price is a downloaded Excel questionnaire emailed to info@pdrnj.com. / "...email it to your pricing inbox"
issues.problem: Minor precision: the destination named on the pricing page is the general info@pdrnj.com inbox, which the contact page presents as the corporate/general email. Calling it a dedicated "pricing inbox" slightly overstates how specific the routing is. Not a factual error about the pricing process, which is confirmed.
issues.fix: Replace "your pricing inbox" with "your info@ inbox" or "info@pdrnj.com" so it matches the page wording.

issues.claim: "the technology page describes Microsoft Dynamics set up per client"
issues.problem: The page says PDR uses Microsoft Dynamics ERP "to manage each client's business"; "set up per client" is a paraphrase that adds configuration specificity the page does not state. Slight over-claim in an otherwise sourced section.
issues.fix: Reword to "uses Microsoft Dynamics ERP to manage each client's business" (the page's own words).

issues.claim: Section 2 impact: 900–3,000 staff hours and $25,820–$86,070 a year; section 3 impact: $13,770–$51,640 a year
issues.problem: Arithmetic is correct against the stated assumptions and the loaded rate is disclosed, but the upper bounds sit above the corresponding estimates in analysis.json (opportunity 2: ~900–2,200 hours / $25,000–$60,000; opportunity 3: ~500–1,850 hours / $12,000–$40,000). The audit's top case therefore runs roughly 40% above the figure the underlying analysis supported, which reads as range-creep even though every input is labelled an assumption.
issues.fix: Either cap section 2 at ~2,200 hours / ~$60,000 and section 3 at ~$40,000 to match analysis.json, or add one clause explaining the wider top case (3.0 FTE x 50% handled).

issues.problem: Not an error: body is ~446 words (about 454 counting the title line), i.e. just inside the ~450-word limit. Flagged only because there is almost no headroom if an edit is needed.
issues.fix: If any issue above is fixed by adding text, trim an equivalent number of words (e.g. shorten the closing italic line) to stay under 450.
